decisions.reason: The turnaround management software is the flagship of the new airport suite, has its own dedicated page, and is central to the firm's apron digitalization strategy.
The connectivity module is the infrastructure layer the other apron software products depend on, so it is likely retained even with modest visibility.
Billing and revenue calculation software for airport services is a natural add-on that monetizes data from the turnaround suite, and it is cheap to maintain.
Equipment monitoring builds on the firm's core electrical apron hardware such as ground power and pre-conditioned air, which makes it strategically aligned.
The resource management module complements turnaround management and is likely integrated into the same platform rather than discontinued.
The safety alert service is a niche, only-mentioned offering with some risk of being merged or dropped, but safety features rarely get withdrawn after just one year.
